extDescription.message: Tailor your CV to the job ad in the current tab with one click.

privacy_point_anthropic.message: When you generate a CV, your CV profile and the job ad are sent to Anthropic through your own Claude Code, under your Claude account terms.

privacy_point_no_server.message: cv-snap has no server. Nothing is sent to cv-snap or anyone else.

privacy_point_local.message: Your CV, profile and settings are stored only in this Chrome profile on this computer.

privacy_point_logs.message: Logs never contain your CV or job-ad text.

setup_checking.message: Checking the native host and Claude Code…

hint_HOST_NOT_INSTALLED.message: In the cv-snap folder run “pnpm run install-host”, then click Check again.

hint_HOST_DISCONNECTED.message: The native host stopped unexpectedly. Run “pnpm run install-host” again, then click Check again.

hint_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND.message: Install Claude Code (claude.com/claude-code), then click Check again.

hint_CLAUDE_NOT_AUTHENTICATED.message: Open a terminal, run “claude” and log in, then click Check again.

hint_CLAUDE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.message: You can continue, but updating Claude Code is recommended (run “claude update”).

error_HOST_NOT_INSTALLED.message: The cv-snap native host is not installed.

error_HOST_DISCONNECTED.message: The connection to the native host was lost.

error_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND.message: Claude Code was not found on this computer.

error_CLAUDE_NOT_AUTHENTICATED.message: Claude Code is not logged in.

error_CLAUDE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.message: Your Claude Code is older than the tested version.

error_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.message: The selected model isn't available on your Claude plan.

error_GENERATION_TIMEOUT.message: Claude didn't answer in time. Please try again.

error_GENERATION_FAILED.message: Claude couldn't create a valid result. Please try again.

error_MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE.message: The file is too large to process.

error_PDF_NO_TEXT.message: This PDF has no selectable text. Scanned PDFs aren't supported; please upload a text-based PDF.

error_PDF_PASSWORD_PROTECTED.message: This PDF is password-protected. Please upload a PDF without a password.

error_PDF_CORRUPTED.message: This file is damaged or not a PDF.

error_PDF_TOO_LARGE.message: The PDF is larger than 10 MB.

error_PDF_UNREADABLE.message: This PDF could not be read.

error_UNEXPECTED.message: Something unexpected went wrong. Please try again.

upload_description.message: cv-snap turns your CV into a profile you review once. Only that profile is used to tailor CVs.

upload_replaces_later.message: A new draft is created from this CV. You'll be asked before it replaces your current profile.

upload_drop_hint.message: Drop a PDF here or choose a file.

upload_limits.message: PDF with selectable text, up to 10 MB.

upload_step_storing.message: Saving your CV on this computer…

upload_step_extracting.message: Reading the text of your CV…

upload_takes_a_while.message: This can take up to a minute or two.

upload_error_too_large.message: The file is larger than 10 MB.

editor_intro.message: Correct anything that's wrong or missing. Only this profile is used as the source of facts. Changes are saved as you type.

editor_invalid.message: Fill in the highlighted fields ($COUNT$ to fix), then confirm again.

photo_limits.message: JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB. Kept only on this computer.

photo_error_type.message: Please choose a JPG or PNG image.

photo_error_size.message: The photo is larger than 2 MB.

replace_description.message: The confirmed profile becomes the only source of facts. Your current profile will be replaced.

panel_error_description.message: The side panel hit an unexpected error. Your saved data is safe.

progress_validating.message: Checking every line against your profile

progress_retrying.message: Fixing lines that didn't match your profile

progress_retrying_note.message: Claude is correcting a few lines. This takes a little longer.

generate_add_site_note.message: cv-snap reads only sites you add. Chrome will ask you to allow this one.

generate_add_denied.message: The site wasn't added because access wasn't allowed. Click Add this site to try again.

generate_add_failed.message: This page can't be added. Only https:// sites are supported.

generate_select_hint.message: No job ad detected here. Select the ad text on the page, then click Generate CV.

generate_click_icon.message: To use cv-snap on this page, click the cv-snap icon in the toolbar while the page is open.

generate_unsupported_page.message: cv-snap works on https:// web pages only. Open the job ad in this tab.

generate_no_tab.message: Open the job ad in a tab next to this panel.

error_JOB_AD_NOT_DETECTED.message: No job ad was found on this page.

error_SELECTION_TOO_SHORT.message: The selected text is too short to be a job ad.

error_SITE_NOT_ALLOWED.message: cv-snap can't read this page yet.

error_INVALID_MESSAGE.message: cv-snap sent a request that couldn't be understood.

error_offline_hint.message: You seem to be offline. Check your internet connection and that Claude is available, then try again.

fix_HOST_NOT_INSTALLED.message: In the cv-snap folder run “pnpm run install-host”, then click Try again.

fix_HOST_DISCONNECTED.message: Click Reconnect. If it keeps happening, run “pnpm run install-host” again.

fix_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND.message: Install Claude Code (claude.com/claude-code), then click Try again.

fix_CLAUDE_NOT_AUTHENTICATED.message: Open a terminal, run “claude” and log in, then click Try again.

fix_CLAUDE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.message: Update Claude Code (run “claude update”), then click Try again.

fix_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.message: Choose another model in Settings, or check that your Claude plan includes it.

fix_PDF_PARSE_FAILED.message: Upload a text-based PDF without a password.

fix_JOB_AD_NOT_DETECTED.message: Select the ad text on the page (at least a few sentences), then click the button below.

fix_SELECTION_TOO_SHORT.message: Select the whole ad, including the requirements, then click the button below.

fix_SITE_NOT_ALLOWED.message: Click Add this site above, allow access, then generate again.

fix_PROFILE_NOT_CONFIRMED.message: Open Edit profile, check your profile and confirm it.

fix_INVALID_MESSAGE.message: Click Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the panel and run “pnpm run install-host” again.

fix_MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE.message: Use a shorter job ad (select only the ad text) or a smaller file.

fix_GENERATION_TIMEOUT.message: Claude may be busy. Click Try again; if it keeps happening, check that Claude is available.

fix_GENERATION_FAILED.message: Click Try again. A new attempt usually works.

fix_CANCELLED.message: Click Generate CV to start again.

preview_unverified.message: Unverified: not found in your profile. Edit or remove it.

result_unverified_explained.message: These lines contain facts not found in your profile. Check them before you send the CV.

result_all_verified.message: Every line was checked against your profile.

result_render_failed.message: The PDF couldn't be prepared. Edit a line or regenerate to try again.

result_all_unverified_title.message: No line of this CV is verified

result_all_unverified_description.message: None of the lines could be checked against your profile. They may contain facts that aren't true. Review the CV before you send it.

result_requirements.message: What the CV was matched against

result_requirements_cached.message: Read earlier from the same ad (saved for 7 days).

result_gaps_explained.message: They are not written into the CV.

result_dropped.message: Left out to fit two pages: $COUNT$

result_dropped_explained.message: The least relevant entries were left out first.

settings_model_sonnet_note.message: Good quality at moderate speed and plan usage.

settings_model_opus_note.message: Most capable; slower and uses more of your Claude plan.

settings_model_haiku_note.message: Fastest and lightest; tailoring may be less precise.

settings_model_applies.message: Used for every Claude call: creating your profile and generating CVs.

settings_language_note.message: The language of cv-snap itself. The CV follows the job ad.

settings_sites_note.message: cv-snap reads only these sites. Removing a site also withdraws Chrome's access.

settings_sites_denied.message: The site wasn't added because access wasn't allowed.

settings_gdpr_note.message: Printed at the end of the CV, exactly as written here.

settings_gdpr_text_en.message: Text for CVs in other languages

settings_gdpr_blank_note.message: Leave a text empty to print no clause in that language.

settings_privacy_note.message: What cv-snap sends to Claude and what stays on this computer.

settings_backup_note.message: Save your confirmed profile to a file, or restore it, e.g. on another computer.

backup_no_profile.message: Confirm a profile first to export it.

backup_blocked_generating.message: Import is available when the generation has finished.

backup_imported.message: Profile imported. It is now your active profile.

backup_error_export.message: The profile couldn't be exported. Please try again.

backup_error_import.message: The profile couldn't be imported. Your current profile is unchanged.

backup_error_too_large.message: The file is larger than 5 MB, so it isn't a cv-snap profile backup.

backup_error_not_a_backup.message: This file isn't a cv-snap profile backup. Choose a file exported from cv-snap.

backup_error_newer_version.message: This backup was made by a newer version of cv-snap. Update cv-snap, then import it again.

backup_error_invalid.message: This backup is damaged or incomplete, so it can't be imported.

backup_error_bad_photo.message: The photo in this backup isn't a JPG or PNG of at most 2 MB.

backup_confirm_description.message: The profile of $NAME$ from the file will replace your current profile and photo.

backup_confirm_draft.message: Your unfinished profile edits will be discarded.
